description: GRAD-RL MaCySTe Maritime Dataset: Live Telemetry and Attack Scenarios from a Containerized FSRU Digital Twin is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Veysel Alevcan (Universidade Lusófona). This dataset contains live telemetry collected from MaCySTe, a containerized Floating Storage and Regasification Unit (FSRU) maritime digital twin, for validation of the GRAD-RL autonomous cyber-physical defense framework. MaCySTe represents the fourth domain validation of GRAD-RL following SWaT (water treatment), BATADAL, and GRFICSv3 (chemical reactor). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
